# A method that returns only an error, such as a health check, reports it as
# .Err: the template renders with .Result as struct{}, a nil error answers 200
# with .Ok true, and an error answers 500.

muxt generate --use-receiver-type=Server
muxt check

exec go test -race -count=1

-- go.mod --
module server

go 1.24
-- templates.go --
package server

import (
	"embed"
	"html/template"
)

//go:embed *.gohtml
var templatesFS embed.FS

var templates = template.Must(template.ParseFS(templatesFS, "*"))
-- index.gohtml --
{{define "GET /health Healthcheck(ctx)"}}{{if .Err}}Unhealthy: {{.Err.Error}}{{else}}OK {{.Ok}}{{end}}{{end}}
-- server.go --
package server

import (
	"context"
	"errors"
)

type Server struct{ down bool }

func (s Server) Healthcheck(ctx context.Context) error {
	if s.down {
		return errors.New("database unavailable")
	}
	return nil
}
-- server_test.go --
package server

import (
	"net/http"
	"net/http/httptest"
	"testing"
)

func TestHealthcheck(t *testing.T) {
	for _, tt := range []struct {
		name     string
		server   Server
		wantCode int
		wantBody string
	}{
		{"healthy", Server{}, http.StatusOK, "OK true"},
		{"unhealthy", Server{down: true}, http.StatusInternalServerError, "Unhealthy: database unavailable"},
	} {
		t.Run(tt.name, func(t *testing.T) {
			mux := http.NewServeMux()
			TemplateRoutes(mux, tt.server)
			rec := httptest.NewRecorder()
			mux.ServeHTTP(rec, httptest.NewRequest(http.MethodGet, "/health", nil))
			if rec.Code != tt.wantCode || rec.Body.String() != tt.wantBody {
				t.Errorf("GET /health = %d %q, want %d %q", rec.Code, rec.Body.String(), tt.wantCode, tt.wantBody)
			}
		})
	}
}
